name: multi-drive-mcp
description: Connect several Google Drive accounts (work, personal, games...) to Claude, each with its own separate login.
long_description: Adds one Google Drive connector that can use several Google accounts without mixing them. Ask Claude to "open the account screen" (or "abre a tela de contas") to see connected accounts and add or remove them. Every Drive action names the account it uses. Logins stay on your computer. Requires your own Google OAuth client (Desktop app) — see the README.

credentials_file.title: Google OAuth client file (optional)
credentials_file.description: The "Desktop app" OAuth client JSON from Google Cloud. Leave empty if it is already saved as credentials.json in the multi-drive-mcp config folder.
